article.title: Conductor公布AEO產品組合，以推薦份額連接內容優化工作
article.title_en: Conductor announces an AEO suite linking recommendation share to content work
article.summary: 11月3日公告把AI推薦量度、優先工作及內容寫作工具放進同一產品方向。
article.summary_en: The November 3 announcement links AI recommendation measurement, prioritized actions and content tools.
highlights: Recommendation Share旨在區分品牌被提及與被積極推薦。
Actions整理內容、技術基礎及第三方引用的改善機會。
highlights_en: Recommendation Share distinguishes mentions from stronger recommendations.
Actions organizes content, technical and third-party citation opportunities.
article.why: 品牌比較AI搜尋工具時，可檢查指標能否對應實際內容工作，並避免把曝光分數直接當作收入。
article.why_en: Brands can assess whether AI search metrics map to practical content work without treating visibility scores as revenue.
article.next_step: 要求供應商展示一個真實問題的原始答案、評分方法及修改後追蹤，確認帳戶開放安排。
article.next_step_en: Request raw answers, scoring logic and change tracking for one real query, and confirm account availability.
article.detail: AEO即答案引擎優化，關注品牌在AI答案中的呈現。Conductor的Recommendation Share屬其自行定義的指標；Custom Market Index則用於界定追蹤市場及問題，Actions把洞察轉成待處理工作。這份公告沒有提供足以獨立判定收入增量的證據，也未逐項列明所有帳戶的開放時間。本報採用11月3日公告日期，不把近日轉載當作新一次推出。
article.detail_en: AEO concerns representation in AI answers. Recommendation Share is Conductor’s own metric; Custom Market Index defines the market and questions, while Actions organizes work. The release does not establish incremental revenue or universal account availability. Its date remains November 3.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
